text: It was Sotha Sil who built us, he himself, the great craftsmer. All others seem to ignore this aspect of him, but we do not. He was an engineer: so are we; he a tonal architect: so are we. It is our sworn duty to build and be like him, for if we do not, we might as well tear ourselves down.

Yes, we have heard. Perhaps this ring will return. Perhaps it will not. But we have word that for now, the ring is no longer real. You have our thanks, and our wealth.

It was a matter of time before the Abstemious found out. Conflicts are something I wish to avoid. Entertainment, after all, is my business. Tell the Abstemious that I shall shut down my ring, in exchange for their help in establishing another diversion from life's horrors.
Under whose authority? Yours? You are a stranger, with no power. Here, the power is in my hands. I run this ring singlehandedly, and you don't get to give me orders. Now please, get out of my sight.
Yes, it is a nice little diversion for the downtrodden, a way to... unwind, after a hard day. Some oppose the... abuse, as they claim, on the fighters, but we must all suffer for entertainment, no?
Talk to Big Irethor-567, he runs things around here.
Oh fine, I've been loaning them out to this 'underground fighting ring'. They meet every night, but I can't tell you where. The closest I can do is escort you.

cell_filter: Sotha Sil, Clockwork City, The Arboretum
text: Old Terreran's verm'cants have been looking worse for gear lately, you might want to talk to him.
Go to the arboretum, find this one who knows of the underground fighting ring. Find this underground fighting ring, and put a stop to it. Perhaps start by asking those in the arboretum?

Livestock, built to live, forced to fight. As lovers of life, we hate that which harms it. One in the arboretum, we hear, helps run this underground ring. Find him, find the ring, stop it. Try not, in any way, to be violent. All life, even that which harms other life, is precious.
I am always busy.
The demands placed on the Chief Foremer are great, and I cannot delegate many tasks.
There's so much to do.  I don't mean to complain, but I never have enough free time.  And all I really wanted to do when I came to Mournhold was to meet someone new...
I am the Tree.

The Gardener has told you that the Arboretum is a lifeform, correct? Think of me as the mind of that lifeform. The Gardener is but an extension of myself, and while he directs the harvest, I direct the growth. I am the will of the plant made real, and I know how to end the infection, though I cannot act to do so.

So, a rogue overclocker group seeks to use the power core to their own goals? This is worrisome, but I believe I know how to reach them. You spoke of a passage opened recently, no doubt found in the attack. I know such a house in which such things may have happened, but the Watchmen sealed it, and even now guard it.

Three of our number claimed recently that they uncovered a passage that lead straight to the grand powerworks. They had been making regular trips, bringing back their research to us, but a few weeks ago they merely disappeared under the claims of being able to ascend to a "higher power". To be honest, I'm not sure they completely know that it is the power core they've discovered. They seemed to be under the impression it was something else entirely!
Aye, a fine wine is like a woman, it uses advanced ah to hell with that, not worth a joke.
Oh no, not that unsanitary penetration stuff, that's disgusting! I am talking about pure love, swapping arms, running around with each other's legs, the good stuff.
Again, thank you friend!

Oh my, I feels good to actually feel my legs. And arms. And anything really. That... skullspider, was it? Yes, that skullspider seemed to want to use my head as its new host! Quite horrible. But I'm a fabricant of my word. Have some gold, and this thing. It's the least I could do!
